text: I feel a strange sense of looping anticipation, as if I’m caught in a cycle of returning. Surrounded by bright colors and displays of research and development, my mind drifts between curiosity and déjà vu. The phrase echoes—a subtle reminder of how easily thoughts can trap me within their own orbits. Is the ship literal, or a metaphor for the places my mind wanders when uncertain? I stand here, feeling time stretching and folding back onto itself.
